editorNote: Companion ARC-AGI-2 report for the special afternoon issue commissioned by Mark Barney.
headline: Special afternoon edition: Arcnights reaches 11th as the ARC-2 gold chase shifts

sections.heading: Special afternoon edition · Arcnights closes on the top ten
sections.text: Arcnights has reached 64.17 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, rising to 11th. The latest recorded score event takes it from 48.75 to 64.17; against the previous close it has climbed six places. ARC Raiders occupies tenth on 65.00 after its own improvement from 64.58. Less than a point now separates the two entries.

sections.heading: A changing gold chase below the leaders
sections.text: Tufa Labs leads on 88.06, Yi-Chia Chen holds second on 83.89 and rabbithole is third on 80.56, all unchanged from the previous close. Majkel1337’s earlier climb to seventh on 68.19 remains a consequential move. masspeaks has improved to 55.00 and stands 14th, above the current provisional gold score of 54.44; 大阪公立大学 shiiin9 is now 18th on 52.08. These are the 1:18 pm Eastern collected standings, and final medals remain undecided.

sections.heading: Argon’s evaluation belongs on a separate board
sections.text: ARC Prize’s new Argon announcement reports 91.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.32 per task in its Verified evaluation. That is a model benchmark result, not a Kaggle entry or a score to insert into these standings. The organizer’s results table agrees with 91.3%, although its introductory paragraph says 91.2%; that source discrepancy is retained here rather than silently resolved.
